calculationAuthority.name: HumanDesign.ai API
calculationAuthority.statement: MCP, Agent HTTP, and REST use the same validated, versioned chart calculation service that powers HumanDesign.ai.
inputRules: Validate date, location, IANA timezone, and daylight-saving context before calculation.
Return ambiguous location candidates and invalid arguments before quota consumption.
Never approximate chart mathematics in the agent.

authentication.apiKey: Six calculation and reference tools only

membershipBoundaries.Free: Create, save, view, and render the connected user's own primary chart.
membershipBoundaries.Individual: The individual membership (internal identifier: solo) adds account usage visibility, while chart access remains limited to the connected user's own primary chart.
membershipBoundaries.Personal: The minimum membership for wider authorized chart, saved-composite, library, and already-owned report access where advertised by tools/list.
membershipBoundaries.Pro: Personal capabilities plus entitled professional workspaces and Website Builder reads and cancellable-run controls where advertised by tools/list.

billing.newPrimaryChart: exactly one calculation unit after validation, preview, and confirmation
